title: The Different answer from the office
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：different　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 different 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the farmer wrote of ① a different answer from the office in the almanac, and everybody in the field said at once that it was ② more different than the one named there the year before. Three autumns on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the farmer, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the different ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most different answer from the office anybody in the field had ever seen, or so the almanac for September 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too different to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the different ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a different way of doing it, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as different as the way of doing it they had once had in the old field. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was different or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the almanac. What the line asked for was ⑦ something different, and nothing besides. The child from the next field called the whole plan ⑧ quite different; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the almanac kept the names of the different ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, in silence, she wrote of another different answer from the office in the same almanac, and the work, which took two autumns, seemed ⑨ more different than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most different way of doing it in the whole field, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the different ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 不同（前置定语 a different answer from the office：1991 年农人在农事历里记下的那件不同的另一答复）
B. adj. 不同／另一种（比较级 more different than：文中两处，一处比办公室的另一答复，一处比预想）
C. adj. 不同／另一种（最高级 the most different：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 不同（表语 too different to do：母亲觉得它太不同，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 另一种（前置定语 a different way of doing it：叔叔把整件事称作一桩另一种的做法）
F. adj. 另一种（同级比较 as different as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩另一种做法相比）
G. adj. 另一种（后置定语 something different：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 另一种（受程度副词修饰 quite different：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a different answer from the office
the most different answer from the office anybody
a different way of doing it
The most different way of doing it in

answers.why: different 意为“不同”，1991 年农人在农事历里记下的是“一件不同的另一答复”，此处作前置定语 a different answer from the office。
different 意为“不同”，此处用比较级 more different than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
different 意为“不同”，农事历上 九月 那行字说它是田垄里最不同的一件，故用最高级 the most different answer from the office。
different 意为“不同”，母亲认为这件东西“太不同了，谁也用不上”，too different to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
different 意为“另一种”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩另一种的做法”，此处作前置定语 a different way of doing it。
different 意为“另一种”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩另一种做法一样另一种”，同级比较用 as different as。
different 意为“另一种”，农事历上那半行字要的是“另一种的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something different。
different 意为“另一种”，邻田垄来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当另一种”，quite 修饰原级 different。
different 意为“另一种”，2001 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要另一种”，故用比较级 more different than。
different 意为“另一种”，母亲 2003 年说的是“整个田垄里最另一种的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most different way of doing it。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，农人在农事历里记下了一件不同的另一答复。（a different answer from the office）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更不同。（more different than …）
母亲觉得它太不同，谁也用不上。（too different to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩另一种的做法。（a different way of doing it）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩另一种做法一样另一种。（as different as …）
到了 1998 年，农事历上只剩半行字：要的是一件另一种的东西。（something different）
answers: In 1991 the farmer wrote of a different answer from the office in the almanac.
Everybody said it was more different than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too different to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a different way of doing it.
He said nobody would call it as different as the way of doing it they had once had.
By 1998 the almanac asked for nothing but something different.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 different 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the farmer wrote of a different answer from the office in the almanac, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most different answer from the office in the field, or so the almanac says.
My mother thought it too different to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a different way of doing it, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next field called the plan quite different, and everybody laughed.
The different ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
